definition_zh: 桦树；桦木；桦条（旧时体罚用具）；用桦条抽打
definition_en: a slender tree with pale bark; a rod made of its twigs; to whip with such a rod
core_image: 白皮修长的桦树，枝条也曾被扎成戒尺
scene: 白皮树在风里沙沙作响，落叶铺满小径。The old schoolmaster kept a birch in the closet.
sceneCN: 这里 birch 是「桦条（旧时体罚用具）」（第 3 个义项：用桦枝扎成的笞具）；句意是老校长在柜子里备着一束桦条。

derivatives.zh: birch 加形容词后缀，义为「桦木的；桦树多的」
同源近亲词，义为「山毛榉」，与 birch 同出古代树名

senses.title: A slender tree with pale bark
senses.definition: a tree of cold regions with smooth pale bark and thin branches
senses.definitionCN: 寒带树种，树皮光滑色浅，枝条纤细
senses.example: The old schoolmaster kept a birch in the closet.
senses.exampleCN: 老校长在柜子里备着一束桦条。
senses.why: The Old English name for the tree, related to an ancient root for bright, for its shining bark.
senses.whyCN: 古英语树名，或与表示「明亮」的古词根相关，指其树皮发亮。

senses.title: The wood of the birch
senses.definition: the hard pale wood of the birch tree
senses.example: The cabinet was made of solid birch.
senses.exampleCN: 这口柜子用整块桦木制成。
senses.why: Tree-names pass easily to their timber.

senses.title: A bundle of birch twigs for flogging
senses.definition: a bunch of birch twigs formerly used to whip offenders
senses.definitionCN: 旧时用桦枝扎成、用于抽打犯错者的笞具
senses.example: Boys feared the birch more than detention.
senses.exampleCN: 男孩们更怕桦条而非留堂。
senses.why: Flexible birch twigs made the traditional school rod.
senses.whyCN: 柔韧的桦枝是传统的校用戒具。

senses.title: To whip with a birch
senses.definition: to flog someone with a bundle of birch twigs
senses.example: Sailors were once birched for small faults.
senses.exampleCN: 水手曾因小过被桦条抽打。
senses.whyCN: 刑具之名转为刑罚之名。

senses.title: Birch bark and its uses
senses.definition: the papery bark used for canoes, baskets, and writing
senses.definitionCN: 如纸般的树皮，用于造船、编篮与书写
senses.example: Native craftworkers sewed birch into canoes.
senses.exampleCN: 原住民工匠把桦皮缝成独木舟。
senses.why: The bark is the tree's most useful part.
senses.whyCN: 树皮是桦树最有用的部分。

senses.title: Birch as scenery
senses.definition: birch trees as a feature of landscape and literature
senses.definitionCN: 作为风景与文学意象的桦树
senses.example: Silver birches lined the northern road.
senses.exampleCN: 白桦夹道立于北方的路上。
senses.why: Pale trunks make birches a painter's tree.
senses.whyCN: 浅色树干使桦树成为画家之树。

senses.title: The birch as institution
senses.definition: corporal punishment by birch as a legal or school practice
senses.definitionCN: 作为法律或学校惯例的桦条体罚
senses.example: The birch was abolished in that country decades ago.
senses.exampleCN: 那个国家数十年前废除了桦条刑。
senses.why: The rod stands for the whole punishing institution.
senses.whyCN: 一束桦条代表整个体罚制度。

senses.title: Birch in folklore
senses.definition: the tree's place in seasonal customs and folklore
senses.definitionCN: 桦树在节庆与民俗中的角色
senses.example: Villagers hung birch sprigs at the spring festival.
senses.exampleCN: 村民在春庆时悬挂桦枝。
senses.whyCN: 树皮明亮、可作净化之用的树易聚民俗。

intro.en: Birch is an Old English tree name of ancient origin.
intro.cn: birch 是来源古老的古英语树名。

items.en: bherəg- may have meant to shine, bright; reconstructed and uncertain.
items.cn: bherəg- 或指「发亮、明亮」（重构形式，存疑）。

items.en: berkjō named the birch across Germanic languages.
items.cn: 原始日耳曼语 berkjō 在各日耳曼语中指桦树。

items.en: birce or beorc meant the birch tree.
items.cn: 古英语 birce 或 beorc 意为「桦树」。

items.en: birche named tree, wood, and the flogging rod.
items.cn: 中古英语 birche 兼指树、木材与笞条。

items.en: the verb to birch and the punishment the birch completed the family.
items.cn: 动词 birch 与刑罚 the birch 补全词族。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers near-spelling tree names; the near-meaning group gathers whipping words.
note.cn: 形近组汇集近形树名；近义组汇集笞打类词。

entries.definitionCN: 山毛榉——拼写相近，或有古代关联
落叶松——拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: to beat with a whip or rod
a thin twig used for whipping

normalIntro.en: Birch is the pale-barked tree whose twigs once made school rods.
normalIntro.cn: birch 是白皮之树，其枝条曾用来做戒尺。

normal.en: Silver birch is the common kind.
The birch meant flogging in old schools.
normal.cn: 旧时 the birch 指笞刑。

normal.en: Birch bark was used for canoes.
The verb birch means to whip.
normal.cn: 动词 birch 意为抽打。

abstract.en: See white trunks shining in a cold wood.
abstract.cn: 看寒林中发亮的白色树干。

abstract.en: Feel the papery bark peel under a thumb.
abstract.cn: 感受拇指下如纸树皮的剥落。

abstract.en: Picture a teacher's drawer and what it once held.
abstract.cn: 想象老师的抽屉与它曾收藏之物。

examples.en: The old schoolmaster kept a birch in the closet.
examples.cn: 老校长在柜子里备着一束桦条。

examples.en: Silver birches lined the northern road.
examples.cn: 白桦夹道立于北方的路上。

examples.en: Native craftworkers sewed birch into canoes.
examples.cn: 原住民工匠把桦皮缝成独木舟。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「脖·尺」——白桦脖颈般修长，旧时枝条正作脖颈后挨打的尺子。

root: 古英语 birce/beorc「桦树」，上溯原始日耳曼语 berkjō，或与原始印欧语 bherəg-「发亮」（重构形式，存疑）相关，指树皮之亮；中古英语兼指树、木材与笞条，近代派生动词 birch「笞打」。

sensesIntro.en: One shining tree lends its name to timber, rods, punishment, and folklore.
sensesIntro.cn: 一棵发亮的树把名字借给了木材、戒条、刑罚与民俗。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: white bark, thin twigs, cold light
core.cn: 核心意象：白皮、细枝、寒光

branches.en: The tree in land, art, and custom
branches.cn: 风景、文艺与习俗中的树

intro.en: Birch is a bare Germanic tree-name.
intro.cn: birch 是日耳曼语光杆树名。

latinIntro.en: No Latin kin; the birch family is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 无拉丁同族；birch 词族属日耳曼语系。
